title.en: Cement names the sections; concrete pump main cylinder seal 95×140 keeps the printed cells
title.zh: 《水泥》只提供章节，concrete pump main cylinder seal 95×140仍用已印格子

description.en: The concrete pump main cylinder seal 95×140 note follows the outline of Cement. The 95×140 main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 95×140.
description.zh: concrete pump main cylinder seal 95×140这篇笔记顺着《水泥》的大纲写。95×140 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 95×140。

h1.en: How Cement arranges a note that only repeats concrete pump main cylinder seal 95×140
h1.zh: 《水泥》怎样安排一篇只重复concrete pump main cylinder seal 95×140的笔记

directAnswer.en: For concrete pump main cylinder seal 95×140, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Cement. Cement only lends its headings. The 95×140 main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 95×140.
directAnswer.zh: 写concrete pump main cylinder seal 95×140时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《水泥》借数字。《水泥》只出借标题。 95×140 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 95×140。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Etymology”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. 95×140 is a two-number mark on the main-cylinder seal kit. Unit: set. Material is not printed. Service life is not printed. The page tells the buyer to confirm the kit against the cylinder bore and rod. It does not define which of the two numbers is the bore. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Some pump pages name a hydraulic pump such as a Kawasaki unit. That cell is not this seal kit, and it is not a spare-part page for a hydraulic pump. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“词源”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 95×140 是主油缸密封套件上的两组数字的标记。单位：套。材料没有印。寿命没有印。 页面要求对照油缸缸径和活塞杆核对套件。它没有规定两个数字里哪一个是缸径。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 有的泵页写了川崎等液压泵。那一格不是这套密封，也不是液压泵的配件页。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: “Chemistry” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Copy the mark as 95×140. Do not normalise 90–160 into 90×160, and do not turn 461K into a diameter. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “化学”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 标记按 95×140 原文抄。不要把 90–160 规范成 90×160，也不要把 461K 改成直径。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Where the source outline says “History”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. The 95×140 main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 95×140. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“历史”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 95×140 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 95×140。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 标题到此为止。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Types” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “类型”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Manufacture”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“制造”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

heading.zh: 凝结, 淬火与 养护

body.en: “Setting, hardening and curing” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 主油缸密封 page plus this size and the quantity. Stop when the printed fragment stops. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement
body.zh: “凝结, 淬火与 养护”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明主油缸密封这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement
